title.narrative: Scale-up of good practices and strengthening local systems for sustainable WASH and nutrition security in Mille & Dubti

description.narrative: Afar is the most underdeveloped region of Ethiopia, affected by climate change, droughts and conflicts. The following areas will be addressed: (1) Access to and sustainable use of WASH & irrigation (systems approach, drip irrigation, solar systems), (2) Nutrition (education, access, medical treatment for malnutrition), (3) Improved food and feed production, post-harvest management, storage, (4) Strengthened Local capacity and coordination in WASH & nutrition. Please do not offer the project to other private donors to replace own funds. The project is already earmarked for a specific donor.

Direct target groups: The proposed project targets 7,500 direct vulnerable pastoral and agro-pastoral households ( 45,200 individuals) in the Dubti and Mille woredas, including men, women, and children, for WASH, nutrition, livelihood, and capacity building support.Indirect target group : 28,000 Households ( 177,000 individuals ) are indirect target groups who will be benefited from water supply and improved sanitation, children care by HEW, Pregnant women and mothers of young children cared for by model mothers).

Goal: Food and nutrition security of pastoralists and agro-pastoralists in the Afar region is sustainably improved.Objective: Local WASH and nutrition systems to improve the nutritional situation of pastoralists and agro-pastoralists in the Woredas Mille and Dubti of the Afar region are sustainably strengthened
